made_for: Farsight team: Aryan Adelker, Chelsea Vaz, Christopher D'souza
statement: Code, data files, text, videos and title art in this prototype are SI generated.

items.code: All files in src/, css/, index.html and tools/cinematics/ (each file has an SI notice in its first line).
items.data: data/*.js. Real-world values come from the sources cited next to them; the files are SI generated.
items.text: Docs, in-game text, information cards, Sources page, story and credits text.
items.videos: assets/video/intro.mp4, ending.mp4, credits.mp4: visible SI GENERATED watermark on every frame, SI notice in the file metadata (comment, description).
items.images: assets/title_bg.jpg: visible SI GENERATED watermark, SI notice in the JPEG comment and EXIF ImageDescription.
items.audio: None in this prototype. Any audio added later must acknowledge SI generation in its description and metadata.
